reason: I already pay the agency to talk to guests, and my laminated sheet answers the Wi-Fi and the rules. Why pay a third time for the same questions? My guests come back because they know me, not a telephone.
objection: My guests like talking to me personally, not to a robot. And I am 68, I don't want one more thing on the phone to learn, check and approve.
would_change_my_mind: If my agency itself offered it included in what I already pay and took care of it, so I do nothing.
